dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire Correction, no short squeeze-shorting is a regular thing and people made just as much money shorting Doge as they did investing in it, implying a Doge short squeeze is going to happen is just nonsense use of buzz words/concepts

@dogecoin_empire Also no evidnece Doge whales selling or even existing, BTC whales exist but not Doge whales I watched the orderbook and orders all lastnight and nothing large enough to move market you taking buzz concepts and applying them to Doge.  I like Doge but stop spreading misinformation.

@dogecoin_empire Where are you getting this bullshit that 'wallstreet' is shorting doge and Doge whales are selling?  The gamestop short squeeze was researched and the stock proven to be shorted but theres no proof or evidence of doge being shorted.  Stop using buzz words/concepts that dont apply
